# Research Workspace

The required research workspace path is `vendor/research/aces-research`.

It is added as a Git submodule from `https://github.com/aces-org-zhuang/aces-research.git` and currently pinned by the main repository index. Verify it with:

```bash
git submodule status --recursive
```

Research process, papers, repository comparisons, candidate materials, and evidence packages belong in that submodule, not in main-repository `docs/`.
